links.outcome: Top-3 diagnostic accuracy on public benchmarks versus real-world consultation cases
links.effect: Public benchmarks: top-3 accuracy 26.55% best open-weight, 42.25% GPT-4.1. Real-world images alone: 1.50%-13.35% open-weight, 24.65% GPT-4.1.
links.quote: These findings demonstrate that benchmark performance substantially overestimates the real-world clinical capability of current dermatology MLLMs.

links.outcome: Model output sensitivity to incomplete or erroneous consultation context
links.effect: Model outputs were highly sensitive to incomplete or erroneous consultation context, although adding clinical context raised top-3 accuracy up to 28.75% (open-weight) and 38.93% (GPT-4.1).
links.quote: However, model outputs were highly sensitive to incomplete or erroneous consultation context.

screen.reason: Retrospective evaluation of multiple multimodal LLMs on dermatology benchmarks and real-world multi-site hospital consultation data to assess diagnostic accuracy and triage capabilities, without testing an organizational deployment safeguard.
